text:
Let the two equal groups each have \(x\) students.  
The smallest group is 10 fewer than each of those groups, so it has \(x-10\) students.

The total number of students is 200:

\[
x + x + (x-10) = 200 \\
3x - 10 = 200 \\
3x = 210 \\
x = 70
\]

Thus the smallest group contains

\[
x - 10 = 70 - 10 = 60 \text{ students}.
\]

Final answer: 60.
